name: Class-D Living Quarters
description: A hyper-modern, clinical dormitory. The walls are composed of seamless white polymer, glowing faintly from recessed LED strips along the ceiling. Eight sleek, integrated bunks are built directly into the structure. The air is filtered to a perfect, scentless chill. A smooth, touch-sensitive blast door is the only exit.

integrated_bunks.description: Ergonomic sleeping pods with antimicrobial white linens. They look more like laboratory equipment than beds.

blast_door.description: A seamless slab of reinforced composite. No handle is visible, only a sleek glass interface glowing with a Level 3 security lock.

name: Automated Storage Hub
description: A pristine white room where robotic arms handle sterile crates behind glass partitions.

name: Sanitation Bay
description: A brightly lit closet containing high-efficiency chemical scrubbers and automated cleaning drones.

name: Observation Mezzanine
description: A sleek platform with a panoramic smart-glass window overlooking the lower maintenance conduits.

name: Main Transit Corridor
description: A long, curved hallway with blindingly white floors and walls. Holographic signs point toward different sectors.

name: Main Transit Corridor
description: A perfectly sterile hallway stretching east and west. The lighting is so bright it leaves no shadows.

name: Sector Junction
description: A sleek corner where the white walls curve seamlessly to the north and east.

name: Sector Junction
description: A pristine corner where the white walls curve to the north and west.

name: Sector Junction
description: The hallway turns sharply here. Every surface is polished to a mirror-like sheen.

name: Sector Junction
description: A curved intersection under the constant hum of high-tech ventilation.

name: Sector Cross-Link
description: A three-way transit point leading north, east, and west through the clinical white labyrinth.

name: Sector Cross-Link
description: An automated junction where corridors diverge. The ceiling is lined with 360-degree security cameras.

name: Sector Cross-Link
description: A sterile T-junction where the white polymer walls intersect seamlessly.

name: Sector Cross-Link
description: A transit node leading through the heart of the modern facility.

name: Central Hub
description: A massive, circular intersection. The floor is made of reinforced smart-glass, showing the core's blueprints beneath your feet.

name: Security Screening Point
description: A high-tech checkpoint with scanning archways and biometric sensors. A transparent Level 2 Keycard is on the console.

biometric_console.description: A sleek, glowing terminal used for scanning personnel.

name: Observation Corridor
description: A hallway with one side made entirely of reinforced glass, providing a view of the containment pits.

name: Local Logic Core
description: A room filled with humming supercomputer racks and holographic diagnostic screens.

name: Anomaly Entrance Suite
description: A stark white transition area. Automated decontamination sprayers are mounted on the ceiling.

name: Research Observation Pod
description: A clinical room overlooking a containment unit. Holographic telemetry data floats in the air.

holographic_data.description: Live graphs and reality-stability metrics pulsing in soft blue light.

name: Containment Unit
description: A high-security chamber. The walls are a mirror-finish alloy capable of withstanding extreme reality-warping events.

name: Researcher Station
description: A tidy, high-tech workspace. A sleek, paperless desk sits in the corner under a bright spotlight.

smart_desk.description: An interactive surface currently displaying a screensaver of the Foundation logo.

terminal.description: An advanced computing terminal. A digital sticky note is visible in the corner of the display.

name: Personnel Nutrition Center
description: A massive, white hall where automated dispensers serve synthetic meals to rows of clean, white tables.
